attention_contract.decisive_evidence: One explicit coefficient-complete recurrence with exact projector semantics, faithful packet, all-strata source jets, representation, and cost proofs, or one exact scoped counterexample.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation; identify the first missing recurrence, contraction, faithfulness, or decomposition theorem.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Supplied moments, free trace, unnamed compression, tuple scan, hidden B^3/B^5 material, incomplete nonreduced handling, transcript collision, or unknown axis used as achieved forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: All three reviews and Coordinator ledger disposition are archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Static recurrence derivation, algebraic counterexamples, representation census, independent review, archival.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Zero experimental computation; formula-level theorem/design and finite static controls only.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One producer, one snapshot, three parallel mutually blind reviews, one ledger archive.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one complete packet and three reviews; stop positive interpretation at any missing recurrence, trace, faithfulness, source inverse, or cost clause.
